name: Look up a record
summary: Finds a customer, order or policy by its reference in one of your lookup tables or your own system, shows it on the panel and reads back only what the caller needs.

defaults.name: base_url
defaults.label: Records address
defaults.help: The address of your records; the reference is added to its end (…/<reference>) and read with GET.

instructions_snippet: When the caller gives a reference, look the record up with {{ kit.tool.lookup }} before you answer. Read back only what they need, never the whole record. If nothing is found, say so and ask them to check the reference; never guess a record.

rules.label: Show that a record was looked up

test_case.name: Finds a record by its reference
test_case.persona_instructions: You are a customer checking on your account. Your reference is DEMO-1001. Answer briefly and politely.
test_case.scenario: Ask what the status of your record is.
expectations: The agent uses the reference before it says anything about the record.
The agent says the record is active.

variants.label: Lookup table
variants.summary: Reads one of your workspace's lookup tables (a spreadsheet you upload as CSV or JSON).

requires.dataset: A lookup table whose key column holds the reference (a customer number, an order number, a phone number).

definition.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_lookup
definition.description: Find a record in the lookup table by its reference. Ask the caller for the reference first and pass it as they said it.

edges.condition: The caller has given the reference of the record to look up

edges.transition_speech: I couldn't find a record with that reference.
I couldn't reach the records just now.

variables.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_reference
variables.description: The reference of the record the caller asked about

variants.label: Your own system
variants.summary: Reads a record from your own system's address with GET (a key is optional; without one the call carries no key).

definition.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_lookup
definition.description: Find a record by its reference. Ask the caller for the reference first and pass it as they said it.

reference.description: The record's reference, as the caller gave it.

edges.condition: The caller has given the reference of the record to look up

edges.transition_speech: I couldn't find a record with that reference.
I couldn't reach the records just now.

variables.name: {{ kit.prefix }}_reference
variables.description: The reference of the record the caller asked about
